mr poklemba.name: Mr. Poklemba
mr poklemba.origin: Mr. Poklemba was the neighbor of Iceman's parents. He was characterized for being an isolated and lonely man due to the fact that he was secretly a mutant. His powers singled him out after they went out of control, resulting in bright lights enveloping his house. When this happened, Iceman was contacted by his mother to help Mr. Poklemba. With the assistance of his friend Rictor, Iceman approached Mr. Poklemba and found him in a state of anguish and despair, afraid that due to his nature as a mutant he would be incarcerated and used as a weapon. After Mr. Poklemba attacked Iceman and Rictor, Bobby managed to cal him down, and offered to take him to the Xavier Institute for Mutant Education and Outreach. Mr. Poklemba calmed down and accepted Iceman's offer.

mr prescott.name: Mr. Prescott
mr prescott.origin: Mr. Prescott was a city contractor and an acquaintance reporter Ned Leeds met while investigating a statue outside City Hall which commemorated the Revolutionary War's Battle of Blood Creek, which in reality never took place. When Leeds' widow Betty Brant picked up on Ned's investigation many years later, Mr. Prescott started to keep tabs on her and stalked her. Additionally, the people behind the secret of Blood Creek started to pursue him. Prescott used a secret underground network of abandoned passageways he knew of to evade them. While Ms. Brant was trying to go unnoticed in City Hall after spying on the files regarding the Blood Creek statue, Mr. Prescott approached her and showed her the underground tunnels. Mr. Prescott explained to Brant that the statue was actually made up of explosive tritium, and could be used as a destructive bomb. Unfortunately, the tunnels Prescott used to move around turned out to house the lair of the Maggia boss behind the statue's construction, Ernesto Karnelli. Because of this, Prescott and Brant were easily tracked down by the Enforcers, captured and taken to Karnelli's base. Prescott, Brant were later rescued together with Dr. Childs, another of Leed's associates kidnapped due to the Blood Creek contingency, by Spider-Man. After Karnelli's plan to set off the statue was foiled, Mr. Prescott joined forces with Dr. Childs to offer tours of the hidden tunnels before they were sealed off.

mr rikleen.name: Mr. Rikleen
mr rikleen.origin: Mr. Rikleen was the defense attorney appointed to Clint Barton during his trial for the murder of Bruce Banner. He noticed a bias from Judge Rappaport in favor of prosecutor Matt Murdock, for which Rikleen privately suggested Murdock investigate his co-counsel Evelyn Stanzler, believing that there was a conspiracy to convict Barton. Murdock eventually discovered that Stanzler was indeed trying to manipulate the outcome of the trial, in order to use Barton's conviction to help General Strakofsky promote the reinstitution of the Superhuman Registration Act, and proceeded to ensure Barton had a fair trial, which ended up resulting in his acquittal.

mr schores.name: Mr. Schores
mr schores.origin: Mr. Schores was a spy for the Nazis who was active during World War II. By the winter of 1942, he was operating out of Freetown, posing as a reclusive old man the locals called "The Hermit", while secretly broadcasting defense secrets to his masters in Germany. During this time, he had also planted a bomb at the local defense factory hoping to hamper the American arms race. Whenever local newspaper boy Roddy Colt (who was secretly the Secret Stamp) came by delivering his daily paper and offering War Stamps, Schores would refuse to purchase any, telling the boy that he was too poor to buy them. This caused Roddy to become concerned over the old man's well being completely unaware of his spy activities. Roddy convinced his father, who ironically worked at the factory which Schores planted the bomb, to offer the old man a job. When Roddy went to tell the old man the good news, Schores told the young Colt boy to leave him alone. Finding Schore's behavior suspicious, Roddy peeped in his windows and learned that he was really a spy but was caught in the act and placed in his spy's closet. Changing into the Secret Stamp while the old man was briefly out of his house, Roddy beat him into submission and threatened to gouge out the old man's eyes if he did not reveal the location of the bomb. Learning the bomb's location, Roddy turned Schores over to the police and stopped the bomb before it could explode. Schores subsequent fate is unknown.

mr secretary.name: Mr. Secretary
mr secretary.origin: The man known only as Mr. Secretary was the Secretary of Defense and the mastermind behind the rise of the Dos Soles Cartel. Together with many other high-ranking officials, including a General in the U.S. Army, they plotted to overthrow the United States of America, only seeing the Punisher as a threat. To do that, they funded and supplied Dos Soles, so that the Punisher would be blamed for the violent actions caused by the cartel's attack on Los Angeles. Unbeknownst to him, the Punisher found out, and nearly beat him to death at the Army Navy Country Club, before Frank realized that he couldn't take on the whole country and that his job wasn't cleaning up the government, but cleaning up the streets.

Due to his work, he often has little time to spend with his daughter. He allows his daughter a great deal of freedom. For example, he didn't mind her attending the presentation of the DISKs in America unattended, and when she joined the Avengers as Wasp's partner, he allowed her to stay in Japan for as long as necessary and even removed the limit from her credit card. He does however worry about Jessica's lack of social skills. When the team had to stay at Jessica's house because one of the DISKs turned out to be there, he and his wife were pleased to see Jessica was finally making some friends her own age.

mr shuggums.name: Mr. Shuggums
mr shuggums.origin: Mr. Shuggums was Deadpool's dog. When Wade went to Genosha in order to kill Mr. Sinister, he mysteriously appeared on the island after Deadpool crashed in an abandoned prison. The mercenary had lost his arm and had his neck twisted, Mr. Shuggums found the arm and made Deadpool chase him until he got it. The canine later led Wade to where Rogue was being held captive by Blockbuster. After being saved, Rogue needed to heal, and Deadpool decided to give her his healing factor through skin contact, by kissing her. Wade fainted, and Rogue used his fighting skills to fight the army of Sinister's clone that approached. Wade woke up, still disoriented, and tried to help Rogue by launching a grenade to his enemies. The projectile was caught by Mr. Shuggums, who wanted to return it to Wade as it was a toy, exploding. The ground below Deadpool collapsed and Wade got his legs severed, falling to a hidden catacomb. The dog was later found safe and sound in Wade's modified flying Sentinel boot, but it took flight before Wade could get on board. When Deadpool later used said Sentinel boot to stomp Mr. Sinister, Mr. Shuggums came out of the landed boot.

mr slade.name: Mr. Slade
mr slade.origin: thumb|left|99px|Mr. Slade Mister Slade was a jungle explorer who was active in the 1950s. During an expedition he slew his jungle guides before he left the region. Returning for other reasons in 1954 he hired jungle guide Greg Knight. Recognized for his past murders by some of the locals, Slade created a creature costume and attacked and killed them, his creature costume being dubbed "The Fang" by locals. The two murders attracted the attention of Lorna the Jungle Girl who went to earn Greg that the Fang was in the region. Greg dismissed the problem while Slade, seeking to eliminate Lorna, took interest raising Greg's suspicion. Slade disappeared into the jungles and pretended to be attack then changed into the Fang and attacked Lorna. Lorna was saved by a lion who attacked the Fang forcing it to retreat. Changing out of his costume, Slade returned to camp pretending to have escaped the Fang. A few days later, Slade changed into the Fang again to continue his hunt of Lorna unaware that she was secretly tracking him. Quickly knocking him out and removing the costume, Lorna took Slade back to Greg. When Slade came to he confessed to his crimes and was turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

mr smythe.name: Mr. Smythe
mr smythe.origin: thumb|left|Mister Smythe Mister Smythe was the lawyer for eccentric millionaire Reuben Hartnett, who was known for his love of practical jokes. When Hartnett died in the fall of 1942, Smythe was to be the executor of his will. Reading the will of Hartnett, he learned that those named in his will had to find his fortune, that the one who found it hidden on his property would be entitled to it entirely. Finding no limitations that prevented inheritance from anyone outside of those named in the will, Smythe decided to pose as the ghost of Hartnett and use the house's many rigged traps (originally used for practical jokes) to frighten the potential beneficiaries or kill them, hoping that it would all be blamed on the ghost of Hartnett. Those named in the will were Hartnett's sister Amanda, his nephew John Howard, his butler Jaggs, and police woman Betty Dean who once helped solve a theft of some of Hartnett's property. Unfortunately for Smythe, Dean brought along her boyfriend at the time, Namor the Sub-Mariner. Despite this setback, Smythe carried out his plan, frightening poor Amanda, killing John with a gun rigged in a door, and almost succeeded in killing Jaggs with exploding cigars. When the Sub-Mariner found a projector and a nylon screen that made the "ghost" appear intangible, he began looking for the man behind the mask. Ultimately, Smythe managed to knock out Namor and toss him down the property well. Ironically enough, this is where the hidden fortune was located, and Namor recovered it. By this time, Smythe had Dean, Jaggs, and Amanda tied to a merry-go-round device that would spin at a lethal speed and send them smashing into the walls of the basement. Namor arrived and struck Smythe in the head with the lock box of valuables, knocking him out. Unmasking Smythe, they all learned the truth and Smythe was handed over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unrecorded.

mr taylor.name: Mr. Taylor
mr taylor.origin: Mr. Taylor was the father of a family of mutants which included his wife, son Billy, and daughter Wendy. When he and his wife were awakened at night by an argument between their children, Weapon X came for them. Mr. Taylor attempted to use his powers to hold off Kane, Sauron, and Wildchild, but was effortlessly defeated by them. His family were subdued by Mesmero not long after. The Taylors were taken to Neverland, the mutant concentration camp, and branded with green 'M's on their hands, denoting powers useful to the Program. Those branded with red 'M's, like Maggott, whom the Taylors had befriended, were immediately put to death upon arrival. When Mr. Taylor confronted the Program's Director about the fate of those executed, he was dragged off by the Boxbots and never seen again. His fate was never revealed, but it was implied that he was terminated.

mr thos.name: Mr. Thos
mr thos.origin: Mr. Thos was an American who owned a number of radio relay stations that were used by the United States Army during World War II. Thos was approached by Nazi spies who offered him power in exchange for betraying his country. Thos agreed to the deal and began plotting the bombing of his own radio relay stations because he could also claim the insurance as well. He personally saw to the planting of the bombs at his relay stations, as part of plan to ruin communications between American soldiers as part of a Nazi air raid on New York City. This plot came to a fast end when the he was spotted planting a bomb in a relay station being guarded by Slow Motion Jones who was the sidekick of the Whizzer at the time. Jones was awoken by Thos' work, and although he failed to stop the bomb from destroying the radio equipment, he managed to clip Thos' arm with a shot gun blast. Later, when the Whizzer was called into investigate, his search lead him and Slow Motion Jones to the Thos Radio Company, where the Whizzer spotted the shotgun wound on Thos' arm. Thos and the spies knocked out the Whizzer and his sidekick and placed them in a room with a crushing roof. Explaining his plans, Thos left for his secret hideout to watch the invasion. The Whizzer managed to escape the deathtrap and round up all the bombs and carry them away from the relay stations before they could go off. With the bombs removed, the military was able to coordinate in time to stop the air raid before it could even start. With his mission a failure, Thos and his minions attempted to commit suicide by jumping off the balcony of his hideout, but his fall was broken by the Whizzer who turned him over to the authorities. The ultimate fate of Mr. Thos is unknown.

mr umbala.name: Mr. Umbala
mr umbala.origin: ===Origins=== Hathor was born in Pilak, Upper Egypt, from Ammon Ra, a peaceful and amorous feline with male and female forms. She partially raised and later married her great-grandnephew Horus. ===Sekhmet=== When the people of ancient Egypt rebelled against him, Ra claimed they plotted against him, and sent Hathor to punish humanity, but her bloodlust transformed her into Sekhmet. A power of destruction, Sekhmet released such fury against mortal foes that Ra feared he would destroy the human race. Legends state that Sekhmet even shredded half of Egypt because her bloodlust was uncontrollable, once unleashed. As Ra himself couldn't stop her rampage, he tricked her by dying a vast amount of beer red (7000 jars). Sekhmet, thinking it was blood, drank herself unconscious, transforming her back into Hathor, goddess of love. To prevent that from happening again, Ra fashioned the Orb of Ra from Hathor's right eye, but Hathor was overcome by bloodlust and became Upper Egypt war goddess. Sekhmet believed that she was originally a lioness that had answered Ra's call to punish the people of Egypt, "steeped in pride and perfidy", and that she was transformed into Sekhmet, Lady of slaughter, divine instrument of his wrath. Hathor was also considered as Sekhmet's half-sister. ===War goddess of Egypt=== Sekhmet is the feline sibling of Bast, the Panther God (also containing male and female forms), who served as Lower Egypt war goddess. One of Sekhmet's first conquests was the demon Apep (the Elder God Set). Sekhmet and Bast maintained influential cults in ancient Egypt, with Sekhmet in Upper Egypt, and Bast in Lower Egypt. When the mortal pharaohs rose to power, the Heliopolitans ventured elsewhere, including Bast who went to Wakanda, and Sekhmet absorbed Bast's power base in Lower Egypt, becoming a patron to the new mortal ruling class. He moved his sect to Memphis and protected the pharaohs in battle for centuries, while Hathor served the people in matters of beauty and people. ===The Lion God of Wakanda=== The Pharaohs' power eventually fading, Sekhmet then ventured to Wakanda, only to find Bast well established there as the nation's patron, and, as the Lion God, Sekhmet was only able to establish a fringe cult. thumb|left|200px|As the Lion God He sought knowledge of the Panther God, so he captured the Black Panther in order to learn his secrets. The Lion God chose to go to Avengers Mansion and threaten the Black Panther with the Avengers' lives on the line, if he would not talk. A fight soon followed, and Thor was able to summon some lightning and smite the Lion God. After his initial defeat, the Lion God watched the Avengers and waited for a chance to strike. He got it when Mantis and Swordsman summoned him directly into Avengers Mansion. As the Lion God was getting ready to burn Black Panther at the stake, Swordsman and Mantis distracted him, which gave Iron Man the chance to trap him inside some adamantium cylinder, whom Thor sent to another dimension. ===Collecting the Young Gods=== Hathor was also one of the goddesses that along with her grandmother, the Elder Goddess Gaea, would collect the Young Gods to be presented to the Celestials Fourth Host as a means to bring a favorable judgement to Earth and humanity. thumb|right|200px|As Hathor ===Protector of Duat=== Sekhmet later encounter Thor again, this time accompanied by Amadeus Cho. During the confrontation, she was tricked into consuming a sedative by Cho. Pacified, she reverted into Hathor and proceeded to affectionately flirt with Thor. The drug eventually wore off, and Sekhmet got to take out her anger against Vali Halfling.

As Ra himself couldn't stop her rampage, he tricked her by dying a vast amount of beer red (7000 jars). Sekhmet, thinking it was blood, drank herself unconscious, transforming her back into Hathor, goddess of love. To prevent that from happening again, Ra fashioned the Orb of Ra from Hathor's right eye, but Hathor was overcome by bloodlust and became Upper Egypt war goddess. Sekhmet believed that she was originally a lioness that had answered Ra's call to punish the people of Egypt, "steeped in pride and perfidy", and that she was transformed into Sekhmet, Lady of slaughter, divine instrument of his wrath. Hathor was also considered as Sekhmet's half-sister. ===War goddess of Egypt=== Sekhmet is the feline sibling of Bast, the Panther God (also containing male and female forms), who served as Lower Egypt war goddess. One of Sekhmet's first conquests was the demon Apep (the Elder God Set). Sekhmet and Bast maintained influential cults in ancient Egypt, with Sekhmet in Upper Egypt, and Bast in Lower Egypt. When the mortal pharaohs rose to power, the Heliopolitans ventured elsewhere, including Bast who went to Wakanda, and Sekhmet absorbed Bast's power base in Lower Egypt, becoming a patron to the new mortal ruling class. He moved his sect to Memphis and protected the pharaohs in battle for centuries, while Hathor served the people in matters of beauty and people. ===The Lion God of Wakanda=== The Pharaohs' power eventually fading, Sekhmet then ventured to Wakanda, only to find Bast well established there as the nation's patron, and, as the Lion God, Sekhmet was only able to establish a fringe cult. thumb|left|200px|As the Lion God He sought knowledge of the Panther God, so he captured the Black Panther in order to learn his secrets. The Lion God chose to go to Avengers Mansion and threaten the Black Panther with the Avengers' lives on the line, if he would not talk. A fight soon followed, and Thor was able to summon some lightning and smite the Lion God. After his initial defeat, the Lion God watched the Avengers and waited for a chance to strike. He got it when Mantis and Swordsman summoned him directly into Avengers Mansion. As the Lion God was getting ready to burn Black Panther at the stake, Swordsman and Mantis distracted him, which gave Iron Man the chance to trap him inside some adamantium cylinder, whom Thor sent to another dimension. ===Collecting the Young Gods=== Hathor was also one of the goddesses that along with her grandmother, the Elder Goddess Gaea, would collect the Young Gods to be presented to the Celestials Fourth Host as a means to bring a favorable judgement to Earth and humanity. thumb|right|200px|As Hathor ===Protector of Duat=== Sekhmet later encounter Thor again, this time accompanied by Amadeus Cho. During the confrontation, she was tricked into consuming a sedative by Cho. Pacified, she reverted into Hathor and proceeded to affectionately flirt with Thor. The drug eventually wore off, and Sekhmet got to take out her anger against Vali Halfling.

mr varley.origin: Varley whose first name was never revealed was once a police detective, working alongside his partner Mr. Johnston. They had both been on the police force for over ten years and were regarded as crooked cops, because they also worked for the Kingpin of Crime Wilson Fisk. One of their main jobs for the Kingpin was to regularly rouse Alfredo Morelli, who was a friend of the Kingpin's son Richard Fisk. They used to rouse Morelli for information on Richard Fisk. One day Morelli told Varley and Johnston that it would be better to work for him. Varley then joined Richard Fisk's payroll and became one of the Rose's right hand henchmen. On the Rose's instructions, and along with Mr. Johnston, they once bribed football player Ray Nesters to throw a game. Varley was later found hung to death by the Hobgoblin in the Rose's apartment.

mr veech.name: Mr. Veech
mr veech.origin: Mr Veech was an inhabitant of the Mojoverse. With the help of his assistant, Nandy, he was able to overthrow Mojo, seizing control of the Mojoverse and its programming. He replaced most of the existing shows with more childish and less violent versions, including creating the Adorable X-Babies to replace the original X-Babies. When the original X-Babies realized they had been replaced and escaped from the virtual reality where Veech had trapped them, they freed his other captives and eventually confronted him. Veech was overthrown and the Mojoverse's programming returned to its normal level of violence and lack of educational value.

mr waspwind.name: Mr. Waspwind
mr waspwind.origin: The Skrull that would adopt the identity of Mr. Waspwind was one of the two Super-Skrulls assigned to the Skrull outpost of Kral X following the aliens' botched secret invasion on Earth. When the sons of Kral X's ruler Don Scarpone spread around the planet their fanaticism for a TV series from Earth called the Ritchie Redwood Show, the two princes converted the two Super-Skrulls, and used their firepower to defeat and force their father and those loyal to him into exile. The two princes then adopted the identities of the show's cast members Ritchie Redwood and Bugface Brown and refashioned Kral X into a recreation of the show's setting, the town of Glenbrook. The two Super-Skrulls also role-played, with one of them adopting the identity of Mr. Waspwind, a biology teacher at Glenbrook high. When the U.S.Avengers arrived to Glenbrook to rescue their MIA teammate Cannonball, Ritchie received them with the two Super-Skrulls read to fight. During the ensuing fight, Mr. Waspwind lunged at Smasher and Enigma and tried to stab them with his Wolverine claws. They used their powers to increase their durability, and since Mr. Waspwind's claws weren't coated with Adamantium, they broke on impact. He was then knocked out by Smasher. Following Ritchie's defeat, he and the two Super-Skrulls were arrested by the Shi'ar forced that assisted the U.S.Avengers in traveling to Glenbrook, so they could face justice in the planet where Don Scarpone and his people had been exiled.

mr wu.name: Mr. Wu
mr wu.origin: Not much is known about Mister Wu, he was a private detective who was briefly active in the late 1940s. His first recorded adventure found him, and his partner Alfie stumbling upon the murder of wealthy stamp collector Jackson Cartright. Mr. Wu investigated the suspects: Cartwright's son-in-law George Willis, Smiley the butler, and Mr. Evan's, Cartwright's lawyer. Wu and Alfie deduced that Evans was the killer when Wu spotted one of Cartwright's stamps stuck to the lawyer's shoe. mr xao.name: Mr. Xao
mr xao.origin: Xao was one of the immortal Lightning Lords. His two brothers were killed by Iron Fist (Orson Randall) and as a result, he wanted to get revenge on K'un-Lun. In the modern day, he offered a 10.6 billion dollar deal to Daniel Rand, who refused. He then welcomed Davos when he arrived at Wai-Go Industries. Xao was later contacted by Jeryn Hogarth, who eventually agreed to his offer. He then forced him to build a gateway to K'un-Lun with the help of Steel Serpent and Hydra. His plan was to destroy the city with a train loaded with bombs while Davos acted as a spy inside the city. Meanwhile, he also made a deal with Yu-Ti to murder Thunderer. However, when Iron Fist revealed that Xao intended on destroying K'un-Lun, not conquering it, Davos defected. Together, the Immortal Weapons foiled his plans and destroyed the portal and the train. When Iron Fist cornered Xao, he realized he couldn't win and jumped to his death instead.

mr yulov.name: Mr. Yulov
mr yulov.origin: Mr. Yulov was Natasha Romanova's case officer during her time in the Black Widow Ops Program. After giving her her first mission in Moscow alongside Dmitri, Yulov later met with Natasha in Havana, where another graduate of the Red Room Academy, Marina, had cultivated a relationship with a pair of government agents, Jema and José Comienza, who were looking to defect from Cuba to the United States of America. Believing that the Comienzas did not trust Marina, Yulov encouraged Romanova to speed up the timetable and thus she convinced the couple that they were in danger and should immediately contact the Americans for the sake of their son, Emiliano. Having successfully made the Comienzas desperate with a strategically placed car bomb to prevent the meeting with the Americans that she had urged, Yulov praised Natasha and then informed her that she would need to remove Marina at the end of the operation as well. Yulov next had Romanova discern the nature of the information the Comienzas planned to give the Americans, but then noted that Russia did not care what it was, they were merely doing a favor for Fidel Castro. He then ordered Natasha to make an example of their deaths in a very public manner and thus she used Marina to lure the couple to the Plaza Vieja where they were gunned down in broad daylight. Romanova then finished her mission by following the last of Yulov's orders, assassinating not only Marina, but her boyfriend, Raul, and even his cat, Suerte, as well.

mroht.name: Mroht
mroht.origin: Mroht witnessed Pyllar freeing the Enchantress. They were then captured by their fellow Ice Giants for letting her escape. King Snagg sent them to Abydos to take the Enchantress back. Mroht and Pyllar were eventually defeated there by Red Norvell. Later, they were both freed by the Lost Gods. Mroht and Pyllar then challenged Seth. They ultimately joined the Asgardians in the final confrontation against Seth on Asgard.

mrrungo mu.name: Mrrungo-Mu
mrrungo mu.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 58: Silver Surfer: The Enslavers
mrrungo mu.origin: The race that would become the Enslavers once dwelled on a dying planet. Mrrungo-Mu, whose inherent great power is of unknown origin, led his people to conquer and enslave others, draining their victims' power to supplement their own, thus enabling them to conquer and enslave greater and greater numbers. By this means, Mu saved his race from extinction. Initially, he did what he did to save his people; however, eventually, the savagery needed to accomplish his goals, as well as his lust for ever greater levels of power, drove him mad. Led by the power of Mrrungo-Mu, the Enslavers conquered world after world. Prisoners of the Enslavers were hooked into machinery that constantly transmitted their power to Mrrungo-Mu and to the Enslavers' starship. After the energies of the captives were exhausted, their corpses served as nourishment to Mu's monstrous royal pets. Mu possessed a large harem, but he kept Tnneya as his chosen woman. However, despite his vast physical and military power and the immense wealth he showered upon her, she hated what he had become, and she denied him her affections as she sought two things he no longer understood: love and tenderness. The Enslavers arrived, causing Galactus problems in finding suitable planets to consume. The Enslavers conquered Zenn-La, enslaving its populace. Shalla Bal was chosen to be amongst Mrrungo-Mu's harem. Voyager III, the space probe sent from Earth years before, was launched an unknown distance at great speed by Galactus. It approached and was pulled via tractor beam into the Enslavers' ship. From this, the ship's scientists deciphered the Earthly message of peace and then used its long-range scanners to locate Earth. They transmitted a message discussing friendly contact, which was ecstatically received by Voyager's designer, astrophysicist Earl Weygand. However, while Weygand excitedly discussed the message on television, the Enslavers' soldiers struck, ambushing and capturing the super-heroes and super-villains of Earth. To prove his power, Mu released a group of heroes—Colossus, Doc Samson, Hulk, Namor, Rogue, She-Hulk, Silver Surfer, Thing, Thor, and Wolverine—and then easily incapacitated the lot of them. Despite these recent additions, Mu's elder engineer, Kalldin-Zo, pointed out that their massive ship required greater amounts of energy, energy that could only be provided by capturing greater numbers of slaves. Mu vowed to continue conquering worlds and taking ever more slaves, but he warned Zo that he would die most painfully if the power stopped. Mu visited Tnneya, who continued to deny her affections. Pushed to the limit, Mu teleported away, telling her that when he returned, she would welcome him properly. Tnneya fled the Enslavers' ship in her private yacht as Mu surveyed a new group of dancers, which included Shalla Bal, whose free will and emotion Mu began draining. Mu was furious upon learning of Tnneya's departure, commanding the deaths of both the flight master and the one who brought the message and then ordering that Tnneya be safely returned. The Silver Surfer, who had been investigating a vision of the Zenn-Lavian's enslavement, came across the fleeing craft of Tnneya and rescued her, disabling the ship pursuing her. The grateful Tnneya was strongly attracted to the Surfer, and she took the form of Shalla Bal, seducing him. After some...romance, the Surfer realized that Tnneya was not Shalla Bal, and she returned to her true form, exclaiming his strength in spirit and love, but expressing sadness that Mrrungo-Mu would destroy him. The Surfer disregarded her warnings of Mu's power and convinced her to direct him to the Enslavers. Upon learning that Mu was targeting Earth, he took Tnneya and accessed warp space to confront the Enslavers as soon as possible. Meanwhile, the Enslavers sent crafts to Earth, using giant suction devices to capture and enslave the whole population, who were then placed in individual life support capsules and stored in gigantic holding chambers, to be preserved until needed. Mu took up temporary residence in the United Nations Building, and he summoned Earl Wygand, thanking him for leading him to Earth and granting him the reward of one week of freedom. Mu's advisors soon warned him of the Surfer's approach; intrigued by the prospect of testing the power of Galactus, Mu had a laser beacon sent to guide the Surfer directly to him. Mu mocked the Surfer, who struck out at Mu's soldiers, but Mu stopped the fight and ordered all others from the room that he might battle the Surfer unmolested. As the others left, the Surfer—having learned of Mu's power plant from Tnneya—transferred half of his power to Weygang, along with the message to use this power to disable the Enslavers power batteries. Knowing that with half of his power he could not hope to stand up to Mu, the Surfer nonetheless fought back with all of his might. Mu toyed with the Surfer, concluding that since the Surfer was such a small challenge to him, Gala

mrs abbott.name: Mrs. Abbott
mrs abbott.origin: When Trance's powers manifested, it appeared as if a ghost had came out of her body, giving her father a heart attack. She was then sent to the Xavier Institute by her parents believing that she would be "cured". After the Institute was closed, Hope returned home and her parents were upset that she was not "cured", so they forbade her to use her powers. Then they was attacked by the Orphan-Maker and Nanny. Hope's parents were almost killed, but Wolverine save them all.

mrs b.first_appearance: Marvel Superheroes: Prince Namor the Sub-Mariner Season 1 1
mrs b.origin: She is the grandmother of King Namor and mother of the late captain Leonard. Namor was born in Atlantis and as a baby he was left without his parents, in his adulthood he returned to the surface and Mrs. B sent her men Freddy and George to look for him. Namor went with the men and Mrs. B told him about her tragic birth. The lady wanted Namor to stay but he refused and the old woman, being very sad, helped her grandson to return to the sea.

mrs baker.name: Mrs. Baker
mrs baker.origin: The mother of William Baker, Mrs. Baker was unaware that her son had become a wanted criminal -- William operating under the alias of Flint Marko -- nor of his super-villain career as the Sandman. Spider-Man first learned of her when, reappearing after having been away for several months as a member of the Frightful Four, Sandman broke away from their fight when he learned it was Christmas Eve, and he made it a point to always visit his mother that time of year despite his fugitive status. Sympathizing, Spider-Man even lent Sandman a gift he'd originally meant for Gwen Stacy so he would have a present for his mother.

mrs bellhauer.name: Mrs. Bellhauer
mrs bellhauer.species: Human with Inhuman lineage activated by a Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids
mrs bellhauer.origin: Mrs. Bellhauer was one of the millions of humans with Inhuman lineage who underwent Terrigenesis as a result of the the detonation of the Terrigen Bomb or a subsequent sweep of the Terrigen Cloud through her area. Due to her reclusive nature, Mrs. Bellhauer's cocoon became hidden in her cellar for the three months of her gestation period. When she emerged from her cocoon, she became a giant green monster and began to wreak havoc across the city. A group of fellow Inhumans led by Medusa subsequently confronted her. Flint contained her, by turning the ground below her into quicksand, and Iso knocked her out by lowering the pressure around Mrs. Bellhauer's head to thin out the oxygen.

mrs berdeaux.name: Mrs. Berdeaux
mrs berdeaux.origin: Mrs. Berdeaux was the mother of Tarquin Berdeaux, better known as "Toad Boy", who was said to be so ugly at his birth that his father left the family out of disgust the very same day. She worked multiple jobs to support her son, who was ungrateful and lazy. Eventually she lashed out at him, but, regretting it, hugged and kissed him in apology, only to discover that the contents of her son's sweat produced the most addictive drug the world had ever seen. From that moment forward, she could think of nothing beyond the next fix, and her once-good looks withered away, leaving her resembling a haggard old crone before her time. As she no longer worked, she eventually fell into debt to the mob boss Frankie Zapruder, but when his men came to collect her, they discovered the new drug her son produced and brought him to Frankie, who sought to expand his criminal empire with it. Both mother and son were taken into Frankie's custody, where the new drug, "Toad Juice," was harvested by Frankie's medics. Eventually, a gang war over the Toad Juice erupted between Frankie's mob and that of his nemesis, Daniel Kaufman, with both Berdeauxs captured by Kaufman's men. In the chaos, Toad Boy and his mother were rescued from by the mysterious reality warper Mister M, who also removed Tarquin's powers with a thought. The threat of Toad Juice was over, but all Mrs. Berdeaux could do was rave and rant over the loss of her "honey."

mrs blanding.name: Mrs. Blanding
mrs blanding.origin: The Blandings were a happy family until one day their son Todd died in a car accident. His parents were devastated by their loss, leading them to adopt 13-year old Alex Summers from an orphanage. Due to grief, Mrs. Blanding sometimes treated Alex as Todd and then felt guilt for it. She and her husband repeatedly stated that they loved Alex for who he is, and tried not to treat him as just a replacement for their dead son.

mrs borkowski.name: Mrs. Borkowski
mrs borkowski.origin: Mr. and Mrs. Borkowski are the parents of Anole. They fully accepted that their son as a mutant, like most of Fairbury's citizens. When anti-mutant sentiment began to spread, they sent Victor to the Xavier Institute for his own safety. They visited him at the Institute during "Parents Week". After the X-Men were disbanded, Vic returned home. His parents were very happy, but he did not himself feel happy or safe. A few weeks later, he ran away from home.

mrs campbell.name: Mrs. Campbell
mrs campbell.origin: Mrs. Campbell was the mother of Jessica Jones, the hero turned private eye. Her husband Dave Campbell took his family on a trip to Walt Disney World with tickets given to him by his boss, Tony Stark. The couple argued on the journey as the car pulled alongside a military convoy, and Dave became distracted. He lost control of the vehicle, which swerved and slipped beneath one of the military trucks, crushing the vehicle as a canister of "hazardous experimental material" tumbled onto Jessica's lap. The car was subsequently thrown from the highway onto an embankment where it landed on its roof and burst into flames, with Jessica the only survivor.

mrs canfield.name: Mrs. Canfield
mrs canfield.origin: Matriarch of an affluent black family in Philadelphia, Mrs. Canfield was often the bridge between her husband and her son, Maurice. Their relationship was further strained by Maurice's political activism, trial and forced enlistment into the United States Army. After losing the secrets of the Super Soldier Serum with the death of Dr. Erskine, the United States Army still wanted to produce more Super Soldiers like Steve Rogers. Col. Walker Price and Dr. Wilfred Nagel forcibly recruited Maurice and 300 other African-American soldiers to serve as test subjects to recreate the Super Soldier Serum. To keep the operation secret, families were sent letters informing them of the soldiers' deaths. Stricken with grief, Mr. Canfield murdered his wife before committing suicide.

mrs costanza.name: Mrs. Costanza
mrs costanza.origin: ===Early life=== Mrs. Costanza, born Danzinger, was a mutant, who was often the cause of fights between boys because of her abilities. On one occasion, the fight resulted in a stabbing, and the stabber described the event as Mrs. Costanza putting him under the spell of a "Siren". At some time, her sister Bethany brought her fiancé Jake Costanza home, where he met Mrs. Danzinger. Jake proposed the very next day and the couple went to Las Vegas to get married. She sent a postcard to Bethany from Vegas, which began her sister's attempts to find her. The Costanza's then went to live in District X, New York City for at least a year, and after eighteen months of searching, Bethany found them. Jake became jealous and fearful that another man could fell in love with his wife, and ruined his life to keep her: He told everyone that his wife was mute, and letting Bethany to talk to her sister, she was able to learn that he was unemployed and was living off benefits, and that she was chained any time he left the flat. ===Death=== NYPD agents Izzy Ortega and Gus Kucharsky were called by Bethany, and after a briefing at Patricia Hamilton's flat, the pair entered the Costanza's apartment. While being freed from her presumed abusive husband who kept her bound and gagged, she mind-controlled Officer Kucharsky into shooting her husband. He then turned the gun on Mrs. Costanza, shooting her to death before attempting suicide. Officer Ortega was able to deflect the blast, saving Officer Kucharsky's life.

mrs daley.name: Mrs. Daley
mrs daley.origin: Private Detective Mark Mason takes on Ruth Daley as a client after the murder of her father, wealthy Reginald Daley was murdered. She explains that her fiancée Dick Wayne is the prime suspect as her father refused to allow him to marry Ruth. When a gun shot was heard in the house following another argument, Ruth's mother found Dick cradling Reginald's death body. Although the evidence is against Dick, Ruth believes he is innocent and hires Mark to solve the murder. Overhearing this, Mark's secretary Louise Grant decides to pay a visit to the Daley residence as the Blonde Phantom to search for clues. Sneaking into the house she begins look around, when someone tries to attack her from behind, the Blonde Phantom flips the attacker over her shoulder and is surprised to find that it is Dick Wayne. Dick explains that he was hiding out to avoid capture. Blonde Phantom is convinced that Dick is not responsible and convinces him to turn himself over to the police. Searching the office for clues the Blonde Phantom finds documents that reveal that Mrs. Daley was selling the family jewels in order to pay off her gambling debts. Searching the widows room she finds a pile of money and a number of IOU's to various gamblers. Believing this is enough to at least keep Dick away the electric chair, Blonde Phantom calls the police and sets up a trap for Mrs. Daley. Inviting Mrs. Daley to Mark Mason's office, Blonde Phantom confronts her with the truth. When Mrs. Daley attempts to shoot the Blonde Phantom, the masked heroine manages to knock her out with a slap to the face before she can shoot and turns her over to the authorities. Later, Ruth visits Mark office asking him to thank the Blonde Phantom for her help, unaware that Louise is the Blonde Phantom.

mrs dane.name: Mrs. Dane
mrs dane.origin: Mrs. Dane is the sister of Arnold, who was believed to be the father of Polaris. After Arnold and his wife died in a plane crash, Mrs. and Mr. Dane adopted Lorna and raised her as their own daughter, never telling her about her real parents. The truth was revealed when Lorna was almost twenty years old. Polaris also found out that Arnold wasn't her biological father, and in fact it was Magneto. Several years later, Mr. and Mrs. Dane attended the wedding of Lorna and Alex Summers.

mrs dawood.name: Mrs. Dawood
mrs dawood.species: Human with latent Inhuman lineage activated by the Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman HybridsCategory:Terrigen Bomb Activations
mrs dawood.origin: Mrs. Dawood was one of countless NuHumans displaced to internment camps by the American government when Hydra took over the country. She was confined in Camp Echo-1, New Mexico. A young Inhuman girl named Kamala, who had been separated from her family, hid in Mrs. Dawood's house. When the Champions broke into Camp Echo-1 in hopes of finding their teammate, Ms. Marvel, who unbeknownst to them also happened to be named Kamala, Mrs. Dawood directed them to the girl hiding in her closet. When a fight erupted between fellow inmates, Mrs. Dawood explained that while some wanted to flee, others preferred to stay. She was among the latter, arguing that while their predicament was unjust, they were well-cared for and they couldn't risk becoming fugitives. When the U.S. Army mobilized to Camp Echo-1 in light of the break-in, the Champions used Viv's holographic projectors to camouflage the entire town and deceive them, giving its inhabitants enough time to make rational decisions. Mrs. Dawood promised to keep in touch with the Champions in case she learned anything about Ms. Marvel, and thanked them for their involvement, even if it wasn't their fight.

mrs dix.name: Mrs. Dix
mrs dix.origin: Mrs. Dix is the mother of Corporal Jeff Dix and Joe Dix. Her son Jeff joined the military and served during World War II. While Jeff was on duty, Mrs. Dix witnessed her second boy Joe get mixed up with small time crook Ed Delaney. When Jeff came home to visit, she told him about what had happened. Jeff caught Delaney attempting to rob the proceeds of a USO show and helped convince his brother to join the Army as well. With Joe starting as a private in the military, Mrs. Dix was proud of her two boys. She said goodbye to her son Jeff as he left for duty on the Panama Canal.

mrs gwynn.name: Mrs. Gwynn
mrs gwynn.origin: ===Background=== Mrs. Gwynn is the mother of Pixie. Next to nothing is known of her past or how she met Pixie's father, the villainous Mastermind. She fabricated an elaborate hoax so that Pixie would believe that her father was a simple coal miner from Abergylid, Wales. For whatever reason, Pixie and her mother have a somewhat strained relationship and don't communicate very often. Despite this, however, she is very protective of her child and tries her best to keep her safe. To this end, she entrusted her daughter with the X-Men at Xavier's Institute. Even after M-Day and the ordeal with William Stryker, the death of most de-powered students and Magik corrupting her daughter's soul, she still trusted the X-Men with her child's life. ===Pixie Strikes Back=== When her daughter was endangered, Pixie called out to her mother magically and Mrs. Gwynn rushed to Utopia to find out what was wrong. Upon arriving, however, she alluded to Pixie's father's origins and true nature while speaking with X-Men Nightcrawler and Psylocke. When the X-Men, in no uncertain terms, told her that Pixie was missing, she didn't take the news well, deciding to find the girl on her own. In doing so, she also showed her apparent magical powers. Mrs. Gwynn decided to seek help from her daughter's half-sisters, Regan and Martinique Wyngarde. She found them in the middle of a fight at Wyngarde Manor, and warned them both that they were no longer the babies of the family. The sisters started to torment her with their powers, but Mrs. Gwynn wasn't impressed with their illusions. She tells the truth about Megan's father, and convinced them to help finding her by promising that, once the three half-sister got united, they would achieve a path of power together. The trio them tracked Pixie to where Saturnine and other demons were keeping her, and Mrs. Gwynn teleported them there. During the fight between the X-Men and Saturnine's demon army, Mrs, Gwynn cooperated with the Wyngarde sisters and Pixie to defeat Saturnine with a combination ou magic and illusions. At the end of the fight, she told her daughter about her father's true identity. Pixie wanted to go away with her mother, but while she was saying goodbye to the X-Men, Mrs. Gwynn teleported away without saying goodbye to her daughter.

mrs ilse.name: Mrs. Ilse
mrs ilse.origin: Mrs. Ilse and her husband James were both spies following the end of World War II. In 1946 they sought to obtain a micro-film that contained the plans to a sun-ray which was secretly being smuggled into Buenos Aires by Madeline Joyce (aka Miss America). Along with them was Louise Remiens who they believed was a Belgium Nazi sympathizer during the war and set him up with a phony American identity of writer Peter Carr. They followed Madeline to La Guardia airport and took the same plane. There they attempted to be friendly to Madeline, especially "Peter" in order to learn where the formula was. Upon arriving in Buenos Aires, the Ilse's maintained a low profile, running their spy network from the basement of the Casa de Lutrio hotel. They eventually discovered that Louise was really Louis Remiens a Belgium resistance fighter, not the Nazi sympathizer they thought he was before and had him captured. They forced a confession out of Louis who admitted that he joined the spies in order to track down the location of Nazi General Kesselwolfe who was responsible for murdering his family. Believing that he was attempting to obtain the sun-ray formula for himself, they had Remiens tied up and found a monogrammed pencil once owned by Marie Varnheim who possessed the formula and went to obtain it from her. Learning that the formula was hidden in a safety deposit box at a nearby bank James had his wife pose as Mary and steal it. James then went to present it to his buyer, Mr. M who turned out to be Kesselwolfe himself. Although James was gunned down in the middle of the exchange, Mrs. Ilse appeared not to be present in during the exchange. Her subsequent fate is unknown. Miss America later recovered the formula and turned it over to the American government.

mrs lowell.name: Mrs. Lowell
mrs lowell.first_appearance: Untold Tales of Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1997
mrs lowell.origin: David Lowell's ex-wife had a very low opinion of her husband. When the police questioned her about Lowell running amok with his newfound power, she told them she had always known her husband was a failure, that she had married him thinking he had a future but he had proved too meek to stand up for himself. She also told them he was up for a promotion that had put them somewhere better than the hole they were living in and that she had threatened to divorce him if he didn't get it.

mrs macik.name: Mrs. Macik
mrs macik.origin: Mrs. Macik was a Ukrainian woman and the mother of Teon Macik, also known as Primal. Following the manifestation of Teon's mutant abilities, she and her husband attempted to regain legal custody of their son, believing that he should remain with his family rather than the X-Men. During the subsequent custody hearing, Mrs. Macik pleaded that the X-Men should not be allowed to decide Teon's future and insisted that he belonged with his family, who wanted to care for him and find a way to help him. However, Teon himself ultimately decided that he was better off remaining with the mutants, and the court ruled in his favor. Later, Mrs. Macik and her husband were targeted by the Friends of Humanity because they were the parents of a mutant. They were rescued by Northstar, who intervened against their attackers. Mrs. Macik later appeared alongside her husband in connection with Teon's story.

mrs malhotra.name: Mrs. Malhotra
mrs malhotra.first_appearance: Secret Empire: Brave New World Vol 1 1
mrs malhotra.origin: After her husband fought in the Siachen War, Mrs. Malhotra moved with him to Denver, Colorado so they could ensure their children would never have to fight in a conflict like he did. While in America, they had three children, Raz, Preeti, and Swapna. During Hydra's conquest of the United States of America, soldiers rounded up the Malhotras in their front yard to force them to pledge allegiance. Mr. Malhotra refused and took a stand, prompting the Hydra soldiers to threaten Malhotra's daughters. Raz stepped in under his superhero identity of Giant-Man, and stopped the Hydra soldiers. The Malhotras subsequently joined Giant-Man, though without knowing he was actually Raz, in becoming part of the Underground, a coalition of rebel superheroes and citizens stationed in Nevada.

mrs meer.name: Mrs. Meer
mrs meer.origin: Mrs. Meer was an American student who came to Draburg with a student visa, and found love there, with Mr. Meer, having a son together, Max. thumb|left|Mrs. and Mr. Meer (Earth-616)|Mr. Meer Mr. Meer being the Draburgian ambassador to Israel, the whole family came to Israel when Max was about thirteen, as Draburg was establishing an embassy at Jerusalem, and were assaulted by an unknown aggressor, in fact Achilles of the Pantheon, in Tel Aviv. They later met Rabin, a Knesset member, who apologized for the aggression and assured that the family was know safe, protected by the mutant super-agent Sabra, and Max befriended with Gretta Rabin, a secretly powerful telepath mutant. After Max and Gretta encounter with Achilles, Hulk, Rick Jones, and Sabra, Max fell from a roof and was taken to Jerusalem Hospital, but the prognosis was that he would remain a vegetable for the rest of his life. Gretta, at her side at the hospital, stated that doctors and Max's parents were wrong and Max could one day awoke, for the two of them to make great things, Max as the figure and Gretta behind, as the true and secret leader.

mrs melrose.name: Mrs. Melrose
mrs melrose.origin: Mrs. Melrose was an old lady attending the Sunday services at a Catholic Church on Mercer Avenue. The congregation was held hostage by the maddened Hotshot, who sought the priest's help to perform last rites on his dead girlfriend, Jailbait. Mrs. Melrose took pity on the boy and witnessed when the Hulk arrived and defeated him. She later visited Hotspot at a special holding facility where he was taken, and told him she would pray for him. Not long afterwards, Mrs. Melrose was interviewed by reporter Jackie McGee about the events that transpired on Mercer Avenue. She painted Hotspot as a tragic lover, and constantly compared him to the late actor , while she described the Hulk as a monster and the villain of the story.

mrs munoz.origin: Mrs. Munoz's husband left when he told his wife that Armando Muñoz was not his son to which she then took it out on him. A few years later, when her son had flying scores on a test, even she seemed happy. She met him during the holidays every year, though they all became less and less of a family as time passed by. There was a day when she started a fire in her own home, and her son saved her. When her son told her that he was a mutant, he got slapped in the face by her as a result. After that her fate is unknown.

mrs pertuz.name: Mrs. Pertuz
mrs pertuz.species: Human with Inhuman lineage activated by a Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids
mrs pertuz.origin: When King Black Bolt activated a Terrigen Bomb above New York City, it released the Terrigen Mist around the world, awakening the powers of Inhuman descendants that have been living among humanity. As the mist engulfed the state of Illinois, one family became affected by it. Dante and his mother were both encased in cocoons prepared for the transformation when they were visited by an outlaw Inhuman named Lash who traveled around collecting the cocoons to see if the individual was worthy of the powers they would possess. Unfortunately, Dante's mother only possessed enough Inhuman DNA to trigger the cocoon but not enough for the transformation which resulted in her death.

mrs rennie.name: Mrs. Rennie
mrs rennie.origin: Mrs. Rennie was Tony Stark's personal secretary. One morning she woke him up and after a funny but ironic telephone conversation between the two, she reminded Tony that she had a meeting with documentary maker John Pillinger that morning. Tony, after the massacre at the FBI headquarters in Houston, called Stark International saying to tell to Mrs. Rennie to deliver his car to him immediately in Austin. Mrs. Rennie was told by Mr. Stark to airfreight his car by corporate jet to Council Bluffs Airport outside Omaha and tell anyone asking he was taking a personal leave. She called him back saying that his car was on its way and that Dr. Samson kept calling.

mrs shannon.name: Mrs. Shannon
mrs shannon.first_appearance: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers Season 1 15
mrs shannon.origin: Mrs. Shannon is the mother of Jessica Shannon. Just like with her husband, not much is known about her except that she is very wealthy and hails from France. Due to her work, she often has little time to spend with his daughter. She allows his daughter a great deal of freedom. For example, she didn't mind her attending the presentation of the DISKs in America unattended, and when she joined the Avengers as Wasp's partner, she allowed her to stay in Japan for as long as necessary. . When the team had to stay at Jessica's house because one of the DISKs turned out to be there, she and her husband were pleased to see Jessica was finally making some friends her own age.

mrs spector.name: Mrs. Spector
mrs spector.origin: Mrs. Spector married Rabbi Elias Spector and had a two sons, Marc and Randall. Her husband was disappointed with his boys' violent nature and their obsession with war, he believed that they should concentrate on their education. She dismissed this as boys being boys. When Marc's multiple personalities started manifesting, they interned him at the Putnam Psychiatric Hospital. Following Elias' passing, Marc was allowed to leave the hospital temporarily to sit shiva. At the reception, she attempted to comfort Marc against his belief that Elias despised him. Marc manifested his alter of Jake to cope, and left to his old room, where he heard Khonshu's voice, and it prompted him to run away. She died some point later.

mrs sydney.name: Mrs. Sydney
mrs sydney.origin: Mrs. Sydney was married to Edward Sydney, and they soon had a son named Kevin. Kevin was a shock to the two parents when he was born a lump of unstable molecules. Initially, both parents were uncomfortable of their son's appearance and he would take on a human form. They would live an ideal family. However, Mrs. Sydney would develop lung cancer, an illness that might have been caused by smoking. Mrs. Sydney died shortly after her son's 13th birthday. Her death caused Edward to become more withdrawn while Kevin would constantly use humor to try and cheer his father up until he was finally shipped off to Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters.

mrs taylor.name: Mrs. Taylor
mrs taylor.origin: Mrs. Taylor was the mother of a family of mutants which included her husband, son Billy, and daughter Wendy. When she and her husband were awakened at night by an argument between their children, Weapon X came for them. Mr. Taylor attempted to use his powers to hold off Kane, Sauron, and Wildchild long enough for his family to escape, but was defeated, and Mrs. Taylor and her children found their exit blocked by Marrow, Washout, and Sabretooth. Though they attempted to use their powers on the attackers, they were put to sleep by Mesmero. The Taylors were taken to Neverland, the mutant concentration camp, and branded with green 'M's on their hands, denoting powers useful to the Program. Mrs. Taylor was put through strenuous procedures in an attempt to extract her powers from her, and eventually became too weak to move. However, she arranged for a passage out of Neverland for her children, by way of Project scientist Dr. Windsor. It is unknown if she survived.

mrs yeong.name: Mrs. Yeong
mrs yeong.first_appearance: War of the Realms: War Scrolls Vol 1 1
mrs yeong.origin: Mrs. Yeong was one of countless of New Yorkers who evacuated to the Sanctum Sanctorum during Malekith's attack on Manhattan as part of the War of the Realms. She was waiting outside for her daughter Jae, and Jane Foster insisted her to head inside before the safe room was closed. Jae arrived afterwards with her friend Chris and told her mother about how Wolverine saved them from a group of Dark Elves. Mrs. Yeong scolded Jae for getting into trouble as they were being transported to the Avengers Mountain. Jae pointed out that Earth's heroes were assembled together, and recalled to her mother words of encouraged that Wolverine had given her; that as long as everybody was fighting together, there was going to be hope.

ms chloe.name: Ms. Chloe
ms chloe.origin: In the 1880s, Ms. Chloe was a librarian who died after two kids popped an inflated paper bag behind her. She was startled, causing a bookshelf to fall and crush her. She became a ghost with the ability to nullify sound, and haunted her library. Miss Chloe's Library was eventually closed down, and was demolished sometime between 1950 and 2010. A music venue called Loud Louie's Dance Emporium was built in its lot. When it opened, Ms. Chloe's ghost emerged and used her powers to silence all of New York City. Squirrel Girl and Iron Man were present when it happened, and tried to take down the ghost to no avail. While other heroes tried to defeat the spectre as it destroyed Loud Louie's Dance Emporium, Squirrel Girl took a different approach and tried to befriend Ms. Chloe. Squirrel Girl stopped her when she was disrupting the rebuilding of Loud Louie's Dance Emporium, and approached her to connect through books. Her plan succeeded, and Ms. Chloe agreed to help Squirrel Girl defeat several sound-based criminals, and also restore the sound to the city. She additionally found a job at the Library of Empire State University. She worked as the overnight librarian, and used her powers to silence people when they were too noisy.

ms coleman.name: Ms. Coleman
ms coleman.origin: Ms. Coleman and Mr. Krane were Norman Osborn's henchmen. They were assigned to a mission to infiltrate the underwater storage facility known as the Lock Box to steal the Carnage symbiote. To this end they joined the staff of the Lock Box. They disguised an arsenal of Pumpkin Bombs as their first cargo, and gained access to the facility. When one of the artifacts in containment, the Zodiac Key, started acting up and Commander Hicks ordered a lockdown, Krane and Coleman decided to blow their cover and attack the Lock Box using the Pumpkin Bombs, killing several staffers and then opening fire on Commander Hicks. They shot their way through the building until they acquired the Carnage symbiote, and subsequently delivered it to Osborn. After merging with the symbiote, Osborn fought with it for control. While having power over Norman's body, Carnage asked Coleman and Krane to come to his office, and brutally murdered them for the sake of it, arguing it was the price Osborn had to pay for "doing business" with him.

ms fischer.name: Ms. Fischer
ms fischer.origin: Ms. Fischer was Baron Strucker's assistant and also acted as the coordinator of the Hydra Mountain Compound, Gehenna, in New Zealand, as well as being the person responsible for recruiting new members of Hydra. During a meeting with Strucker, Ms. Fischer pointed out that the recruitment rate was booming and also the financial recovery was excellent while the siphoning of the decommissioned technological assets from SHIELD continued but there was a breach in security by Nick Fury. Later she welcomed and congratulated the new recruit in the Hydra which turned out to be the perfect choice to become the living symbol of the Hydra, the Hive. Ms. Fischer took stock of the disastrous situation the Hydra was facing with the only members of the High Council not to have abandoned, Baron Strucker and Kraken (in fact an infiltrated Jake Fury), after the battle against Leviathan with the involvement of the Caterpillars led by Nick Fury. Ms. Fischer was later tracked down by Punisher, who was searching for Baron Zemo. At first she thought he was rescuing her from a stalker, but soon realized that he was actually after her. Punisher attacked her, presumably killing her. A police officer called both her and the stalkerin as an nonresponsive knife wound victims.

ms kaufman.name: Ms. Kaufman
ms kaufman.origin: When Cassandra discovered she was pregnant, she left Tod Kaufman because he was working for HYDRA and she didn't want their daughter to know her father is a monster. Cassandra's daughter turned out to be a mutant with razor pointed spikes sprouting from various parts of her body. At some point, she contracted a rare blood disease and required a bone marrow transplant to survive. To save her life Cyclops dispatched Wolverine and X-Force to infiltrate Hydra Base 2994 and kidnap General Kaufman. X-Force forcibly brought Kaufman to Saint Francis Memorial Hospital in San Francisco where they explained his daughter's illness and the need for his bone marrow. Before he could reply, HYDRA stormed into the hospital to extract Kaufman. Without time to give a proper sample, Kaufman allow Wolverine to cut off his left arm, before leaving. Presumably, with the bone marrow from her father, she recovered from her illness. Her current whereabouts are unknown.

ms peters.name: Ms. Peters
ms peters.origin: Ms. Peters was a teacher at a school which was renamed Daniel Whitehall Elementary and Middle School when Hydra conquered the United States under Captain America's leadership. She taught history, and proceeded to give lessons on Hydra's vision of the past following the take-over. During one of Ms. Peters classes, student Marcus Festerman accused the brother of his classmate Jason McAllister of being a freak, which led to his arrest and imprisonment in an Inhuman detention camp. Following the fall of the Hydra empire, and Brian McAllister's return to his and Jason's home after being liberated from Hydra's detention camp, Ms. Peters and the rest of Jason's class volunteered to help clean up his house, which had been vandalized in Brian's absence, feeling remorseful for what he had to enture under Hydra's regime.

ms quizzler.origin: Ms. Quizzler was a super-villain obsessed with proving that she was the smartest person alive. 200px|left|thumb|Ms. Quizzler quizzing Doreen Green (Earth-616)|Squirrel Girl, She-Hulk, Thor, and Tippy-Toe To prove her intelligence, Ms. Quizzler kidnapped Peter Parker and Nancy Whitehead from Empire State University. To save the hostages, Squirrel Girl, She-Hulk, and Thor all had to complete a series of riddles and quizzes. Thankfully, while Ms. Quizzler was distracted, Tippy-Toe and the other Squirrel Scouts were able to locate and free Peter and Nancy. After her defeat and with some coaxing from Squirrel Girl, Ms. Quizzler decided to apply her knowledge to solving global issues such as providing sustainable energy, ending international conflicts, and solving income inequality, instead of super-villainy.

ms yoshida.name: Ms. Yoshida
ms yoshida.origin: Nothing is known of Ms. Yoshida's past, save that she was a telepathic mutant who rejected the ideals of both Professor X and Magneto, instead using her gift to become wealthy in the business world. At some point, she met the Gauntlet, a group of others like her, including Mr. Beckham, Lau, and Helen Burnside, and they discovered, that if they combined their powers, they could access other worlds in the Multiverse. On one such occasion, on a visit to a reality "down-spiral" (meaning less-advanced) than Earth-616, they discovered a race of highly-adaptable creatures inhabiting a nearly-destroyed version of Earth. The Gauntlet decided they could exploit these beings to make money, and so kidnapped the race's children in hopes of using their body parts to corner the market on donor organs. However, one of the adult creatures followed them back, killed Beckham, and threatened to come for the rest of them. The attack alerted X-Man, who had become mutantkind's "shaman," to the threat facing the mutants. Nate met with the Gauntlet, but the down-spiral creature attacked again. The creature fought Nate as the Gauntlet, including Yoshida, escaped. Nate defeated the creature, but in the process scanned its mind to learn of its problem with the Gauntlet. Following this, Nate contacted Yoshida to learn the Gauntlet's story, but was pulled into the broken reality before he could learn it, face-to-face with the creature, who revealed to him the horrible truth. Upon Nate's return, he executed the Gauntlet for their crimes, Ms. Yoshida being the first to die. The others quickly followed, all except Helen Burnside, whose idea it was to steal the children. She was left in the broken world, for the creatures to do with as they saw fit.

muatu.name: Muatu
muatu.origin: Muatu was a dog living in the Ghudazai refugee camp outside of Wakanda when Achebe launched his revolution to seize the Wakandan throne. During the fighting, Muatu was injured- losing an eye, though he was treated and stabilized after the fighting ended. During his first national press conference, Achebe had Muatu brought out and used as a symbol of the healing that his reign would bring to both the Wakandans and the Refugees- and invited both sides to join him in prayer. He quickly came to adopt Muatu as a mascot for his reign, and in a subsequent broadcast, held the dog as he declared a national day of mourning, followed by a new national holiday- Biscuit Day, in which the people of Wakanda would eat nothing but biscuits from dawn to dusk. As he continued to make televised appearances and spread propaganda of his reign, Achebe continued to parade Muatu around with him- prominently featuring him on mass produced propaganda posters and posing with him for video shoots with children.

mubahn.name: Mubahn
mubahn.origin: Mubahn is the king of the Demon People, natives of a timeless dimension. He rules over the Demon People with an iron fist; those who do not follow his commands are enslaved to do his bidding. Trapped in this dimension due to the one-way portal between this realm and Earth, Mubahn sought a means to break the barrier and take over the Earth. This came when American soldier Breeze Barton stumbled through the barrier and deduced that magnetism was the key to breaching the barrier and returning home. Seeking to steal this technology, Mubahn kidnapped the human scientist Zanoba to learn the secret to magnetism. Breeze Barton led an army in attacking the Demon City and ultimately slew Mubahn in battle. Following the downfall of Mubahn, his slaves were freed by Barton.

muck monster.name: Muck Monster
muck monster.origin: A carnival performer apparently made of swamp muck, Muck Monster and the rest of his fellow performers had their souls stolen by the magician Moondark and turned into his mindless slaves. The carnival was freed from Moondark by Spider-Man and Ghost Rider and their souls returned. After being liberated, Muck Monster left the carnival, along with Gorilla Girl and Six, to seek their own fortunes. As they were crossing a moonlit country road, a speeding car swerved to avoid them and crashed. Muck Monster's shapeshifting friend, still in her ape form, blamed the accident on their grotesque appearances, and insisted that they help. Muck Monster was unsympathetic, but the other two overruled him. The trio used their abilities(Muck Monster used his mossy body to dampen the flames) to rescue the driver, a frantic Dr. Melloncamp from the burning vehicle, only to realize that it wasn't the Freaks that frightened her. A moment later, Hammer and Anvil arrived and bowled the Freaks over. They explained that Dr. Melloncamp was too valuable to be let go and that they intended to keep her as a prisoner. Seeing the doctor's plight, Six ignored his friends' protests and leapt at the two criminals, only to be tossed aside. But the other two freaks wouldn't let him fight alone. While Hammer was distracted by the shapeshifter in the form of a beautiful woman, Muck Monster swatted Anvil to the ground with a tree trunk. Hammer turned back to his partner, only for the beauty he'd been staring at to transform into a gorilla and punch him out with her hairy paw. Gorilla Girl joked that she had more than one way of "turning men's heads." muck monster.bio: A carnival performer apparently made of swamp muck, Muck Monster and the rest of his fellow performers had their souls stolen by the magician Moondark and turned into his mindless slaves. The carnival was freed from Moondark by Spider-Man and Ghost Rider and their souls returned. After being liberated, Muck Monster left the carnival, along with Gorilla Girl and Six, to seek their own fortunes. As they were crossing a moonlit country road, a speeding car swerved to avoid them and crashed. Muck Monster's shapeshifting friend, still in her ape form, blamed the accident on their grotesque appearances, and insisted that they help. Muck Monster was unsympathetic, but the other two overruled him. The trio used their abilities(Muck Monster used his mossy body to dampen the flames) to rescue the driver, a frantic Dr. Melloncamp from the burning vehicle, only to realize that it wasn't the Freaks that frightened her. A moment later, Hammer and Anvil arrived and bowled the Freaks over. They explained that Dr. Melloncamp was too valuable to be let go and that they intended to keep her as a prisoner. Seeing the doctor's plight, Six ignored his friends' protests and leapt at the two criminals, only to be tossed aside. But the other two freaks wouldn't let him fight alone. While Hammer was distracted by the shapeshifter in the form of a beautiful woman, Muck Monster swatted Anvil to the ground with a tree trunk. Gorilla Girl joked that she had more than one way of "turning men's heads." mud.name: Mud
mud.origin: The Brothers Four claim to have been created and taught their magical powers by the wizard posing as Merlin for the purposes of seeking out and destroying Modred the Mystic. Their numbers included the earth elemental Mud, the fire element known as Fire, the water element known as Hydro, and the air element Aero. They were placed in stasis within a chest that eventually ended up beneath British Parliament. The brothers were inadvertently freed by two thieves seeking to recover stolen Nazi loot hidden in Parliament during World War II. Materializing in a cavern below Stonehenge and began capturing tourists to drain them of the energies they needed to pull Modred back in time and return him to their master. Their arrival drew the visiting heroes Spider-Woman, the Fantastic Four's Thing and the Thing's girlfriend Alicia Masters. The Thing and Spider-Woman battled the creatures until Modred -- sensing the elemental's arrival came. Modred then used his superior magics to turn each elemental against their opposite, the powers of one cancelling out the other, destroying the Four Brothers before they could complete their mission.

mud pi.name: Mud Pi
mud pi.origin: Mud Pi was a subterranean behemoth, possibly one of the Old Ones, who lived beneath the Earth since time immemorial. Sick of the noise of civilization, he threatened humanity to regain silence, by eliminating them, starting by the citizens of Wash Basin, Texas, through his Bowl o' Death. He explained his intentions to Captain Ultra, who burst at him in anger as those people were the missing audience of his stand-up comedy show. As Mud Pi re-formed himself in seconds after being dispersed by Captain Ultra's blows, Captain Ultra used the townspeople's cloth on Mud Pi, who was absorbed into the material. Captain Ultra finished him by plunging him into his own Bowl o' Death.

mud thing.name: Mud-Thing
mud thing.species: Created when Sandman and Hydro-Man fused together
mud thing.origin: When Sandman and Hydro-Man accidentally slammed together, their molecules combined to become the Mud-Thing. Unlike the two men who formed it, Mud-Thing seemed to be a mindless brute with only vague memories of their lives before. Because of this, it sought out, without fully understanding why, Sadie Frickett, whom both the Sandman and Hydro-Man had feelings for. When it found her, she sensed a friendly aura about the monster and, rather than allow the police or Spider-Man to harm it, Sadie petitioned attorney Matt Murdock to help her gain legal custody of the beast. The creature soon gained popularity among the public as a Broadway showpiece, with Sadie raking in the cash made by the Mud-Thing's appearance. However, when it saw her kiss the showbiz agent in an act of excitement, memories of Hydro-Man and Sandman's love for the woman sent the Mud-Thing into a blind rage, and it started destroying everything in sight. Only the sound of Sadie's voice could calm the creature out of its rampage. It grabbed her in its hand and fled with her after sensing the authority's attempts to destroy it. The Mud-Thing met its end when it climbed to the top of a New York skyscraper where police helicopters were waiting. The choppers began spraying it with a special chemical formula that dried up its body and caused it to crumble apart until it was nothing more than chunks of dirt scattered across the pavement. The remains of Mud-Thing were gathered up by the NYPD who attempted to separate Sandman and Hydro-Man using various chemical and radiation treatments. When nothing worked, the remains were tossed in a dump where the two criminals finally separated after the last radiation took effect.

mujaji.name: Mujaji
mujaji.origin: Mujaji was among the Orisha, the pantheon of Wakanda. Mujaji was a goddess of sustenance, and would be beseeched by the mortals to fed them in times of hunger. The Orisha, including Mujaji, originated during immeorial times before the land of Wakanda even had a name. When the pilgrims who traveled to this land entered in conflict with the native beasts that lived on it, the Originators, the heroes that rose among the humans were ascended to gods on faith. The humans and the Orisha defeated the originators and banished them to the Nether-Realms beyond a group of gates. As part of their duty, the Orisha became guardians of these gates.

muktong mollie.name: Muktong Mollie
muktong mollie.origin: The woman known as Muktong Mollie was a guerrilla soldier who was active in Korea during the Korean War. She was a soldier of fortune, having no loyalty to any side of the conflict as she was merely motivated by money. During the course of the war she became aware of a ransom of 10,000 Wan being offered by Colonel Feng of the People's Liberation Army of China, who sought the capture of American soldiers Hank "Combat" Kelly and Cookie Novak for various attacks on Chinese interests during the war. Mollie and her guerrilla warriors gunned down Chinese soldiers just to insure that she could capture Combat and Cookie and claim the reward. She turned the two Americans over to Colonel Feng who had the pair dumped into a water tank with an octopus to be crushed to death. Much to the doomed American's surprise, Mollie dived in after them and saved their lives by killing the squid. She explained that she was setting them free in the hopes of capturing them again for a much higher reward. After Combat and Cookie slew Colonel Feng the raided his safe and recovered his money. They then paid Mollie and her guerrilla fighters to provide them covering fire while they fled reinforcements. Learning that Combat and Cookie's old foes were seeking to get revenge against them, Mollie tracked them down and prevented them from being eliminated by the Korea Katie so she could claim the reward on their heads. However, her chance for revenge was foiled by the interventions of the Panther Lady, Yalu River Rosie, Korea Katie, and General Olga other enemies of the two Americans who also sought the right to get revenge. Ultimately, the five women began to fight among themselves allowing Combat and Cookie to free themselves and take them all prisoner.

fields.history: The woman known as Muktong Mollie was a guerrilla soldier who was active in Korea during the Korean War. She was a soldier of fortune, having no loyalty to any side of the conflict as she was merely motivated by money. During the course of the war she became aware of a ransom of 10,000 Wan being offered by Colonel Feng of the People's Liberation Army of China, who sought the capture of American soldiers Hank "Combat" Kelly and Cookie Novak for various attacks on Chinese interests during the war. Mollie and her guerrilla warriors gunned down Chinese soldiers just to insure that she could capture Combat and Cookie and claim the reward. She turned the two Americans over to Colonel Feng who had the pair dumped into a water tank with an octopus to be crushed to death.
